images.title: 2-4-_MG_0259
images.alt: Close profile of a woman with her eyes closed against a rusted metal shutter, punk safety pins in her dark hair above Westwood-style pearls and an embroidered drape, from a Fashion Communication student concept shoot imagining House of Anita Dongre meeting Vivienne Westwood.

images.title: 3-2-_MG_0276
images.alt: A woman seated on bare earth against a stacked red-brick wall, turning to look at the camera, a soft embroidered sari drape met by a sculpted black corset: the Dongre romanticism and Westwood defiance this student concept shoot was built to contrast.
